from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEquity(BaseModel):
    """One company's reported equity attributable to parent company shareholders from their financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the document")
    equity_value: float | None = Field(description="The reported equity value in yuan; None if not found")
    equity_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label used in the document (e.g., '归属于上市公司股东的所有者权益')")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period mentioned in the document (e.g., '2024年第一季度')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the reported value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_equities: list[CompanyEquity]
